title: Oregon DA Public Records Order — MCED 2 Malheur Enterprise 06.22 (Malheur; County)
text:
DAVID M. GOLDTHORPE BRENDON ALEXANDER
District Attorney Chief Deputy District Attorney
MALHEUR COUNTY DISTRICT
ATTORNEY
251 B Street West #6
Vale, Oregon 97918
[541] 473-5127
Facsimile [541] 473-5199
Juue 27, 2022
Re: Public Records Petition of Malheur Enterprise, dated June 15, 2022
Dear Mr. Zaitz and Mr. Smith:
This letter will serve as the District Attorney's opinion on your appeal of denial of public records. Your appeal
relates to requests for records from Malheur County, specifically Malhuer County Economic Development and
Greg Smith. The request was for the most recent budget prepared by Anderson Perry & Associates related to the
construction of the TVRC.
The MCED responded with a photo of what appears to be a scribbled-on budget document being held by
someone at a distance from the camera.
This was not responsive. It is 2022. Any current budget document should exist on a firm's or the MCED's
computer in some electronic form. This actual/official budget document or documents would be responsive and
must be provided. If somehow this photographed document IS the official working budget of the MCED and
Anderson Perry for the TVRC project, it must be scanned in or photo copied. A photograph from a distance of
one page of what looks like a multi-page document is not a satisfactory response.
I also hereby waive any fees or costs of production for this request. Any fees or costs already collected in
regards to this request (if they exist) must be refunded to the petitioner.
Please let me know if you have any questions.
Sincerely,
~
David M. Goldthorpe
District Attorney
